pauseUiTimingReview.sourceConditions: updateMenus lines234-245 uses game.phase. paused generates pauseMenu, unhides menu-layer and sets game-shell data-phase paused. updateUi342-345 invokes it; animate calls updateUi after renderer.render and only when now-lastUi>=100. Model update and snapshot are not an atomic rendered-frame/DOM-presentation assertion.
pauseUiTimingReview.captureSequence: Wait for model paused, wait180ms, read before, wait300ms, read after, assert model freeze, then adb exec-out screencap -p. The driver does not wait for menu-layer visibility, pause text or compositor frame presentation.
pauseUiTimingReview.snapshotDocument: Both frozen observations report document visible and focused at960x540. They do not include DOM menu state.
pauseUiTimingReview.conclusion: The original model pause test passed. This static PNG does not show the pause menu. Source expects a pause dialog on a subsequent UI update, but these records do not establish whether the missing dialog was a presentation delay or another cause. No claim of simultaneous model/DOM paint or new production defect is made.
